audited_differences.assessment: Adds a direct-age fallback for public clock line-search failures. The UCLN internal clock initializer explicitly passes _direct_age_fallback=False, retaining its validated initialization path.
Adds an optional args=() pass-through. Existing UCLN calls omit it and therefore retain identical arguments and fitted-value behavior.
Explicitly disables the new clock fallback for the internal UCLN start; the validated profiled UCLN optimizer, objective, starts, and selection are unchanged.
Previously audited start_kind exception metadata remains additive and does not alter successful-result selection.

Adds private, opt-in _initial_rates/_initial_ages continuation starts for V18 lambda paths and additive start-kind metadata. When those arguments are omitted, the validated default start vectors and RNG sequence are unchanged; six deterministic four-start fits across three seeds and two lambdas were bit-identical to an isolated 59cbdf0 archive.
